title: Comments: the data model
summary: Design review: the schema drawn as a diagram, the endpoints in a table, then the open choices: threading, IDs, deletion, pagination.
description: Comments on posts, with replies and reactions. Here is the schema and the API as I'd build them. A few choices are yours; my picks are pre-selected, with why.

fields.label: Endpoints
fields.text:
| Route | Does |
|---|---|
| `GET /posts/:id/comments` | list, newest first, paged |
| `POST /posts/:id/comments` | add; `parent_id` for a reply |
| `PATCH /comments/:id` | edit, author only |
| `DELETE /comments/:id` | delete, author or post owner |
| `PUT /comments/:id/reactions/:emoji` | toggle a reaction |

fields.label: How deep do replies go?
fields.help: One level reads well on a phone and keeps the list a single query.

options.label: One level
options.description: Replies under a comment, no replies to replies (like Slack threads)

options.label: A full tree
options.description: Any depth (like Reddit); needs a recursive query

options.label: UUID v7
options.description: Sortable by time, safe to show in URLs

options.label: Auto-increment integers
options.description: What posts use today; leaks the comment count

options.description: Soft delete: the row keeps deleted_at, the body is wiped
